subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should portable pre-processing acknowledgment text become an initial phase of the existing channel streaming/progress lifecycle, or a separate global messages.ackText contract?
rationale: Both designs are feasible, but they create different long-term ownership, configuration, plugin-API, notification, and cleanup contracts; repository policy sets a high bar for adding another root config surface.

options.title: Extend progress lifecycle
options.body: Add a portable pre-dispatch status phase to shared streaming/presence contracts, with channel capability fallbacks and explicit cleanup semantics.

options.title: Add messages.ackText
options.body: Create a separate global acknowledgment-text configuration mirroring ackReaction scopes, accepting a second source of visible progress policy.

options.title: Keep existing signals only
options.body: Rely on reactions, typing, and current per-channel progress drafts without promising portable immediate text.

recommendation.title: Extend progress lifecycle
recommendation.body: Add a portable pre-dispatch status phase to shared streaming/presence contracts, with channel capability fallbacks and explicit cleanup semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history and prior issue review most directly connect steipete to shared reply lifecycle behavior and the cross-channel product boundary.
